statement: Among OUTSIDE_GENE primary-intergenic MOP occurrences within 100 bp of a gene boundary and with a non-tied nearest end, the fraction nearest a 5-prime gene boundary will exceed the genome-matched intergenic background fraction.
support_condition: observed/expected >1 and one-sided 20,000-replicate Monte Carlo tail <=0.05; strong support <=0.01.
contamination_boundary: Frozen before any observed intergenic boundary orientation/end-side result was calculated.
